notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). SPEPEToken has a no-argument constructor that mints all 1,000,000,000 SPEPE (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender. Supply is fixed forever; there is no subsequent minting, burning, owner, administration, proxy or upgradeability. Transfers are plain ERC-20 with no fee, tax or transfer limit. No application contracts are deployed. The launch factory handles distribution, pool seeding from its deployer balance and forwarding any remainder to economics.remainderTo. Swaps use Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. pool.initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 provenance for paired-currency minor units per SPEPE minor unit with SPEPE as currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, token.totalSupply and the deployed currency order.
